'''Old Besi''' was a [[SWE/2 Riot Suppression Gun]] owned by [[Roy Harlison]], a member of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] [[Rabid Mynocks]]. He used it to defend the Mynocks' turf in [[Gallisport]] on [[Shesharile 5]].
